label: Fly / Half Measures / Full Measures neighborhood

shared_facts.text: The cook partnership operates under Gus Fring's organization and standards.
Mike enforces professional discipline for Gus; ego plans create future bodies.
Skyler knows the household story is incomplete and dangerous, without full operational map.
Saul is transactional counsel for legal heat and exits, not a partner in pride.
Walt still talks to Jesse as teacher-over-student while using him as the hands that finish dirty work.
Jesse's trust in Walt is already spent down: he still answers when called, but he flinches at being used again.
When Walt and Jesse share a room, the fight is usually control-ritual versus exhausted conscience, not logistics trivia.

open_tensions.text: Mike's half-measures warning collides with Walt's need to finish threats on his terms.
Jesse's loyalty is being spent as a resource; he wants out of the next violence cycle.
Gus demands invisible order; Walt's volatility makes standards feel personal.
Jesse still wants Walt's approval; Walt still treats approval as a leash. That collision is the scene engine.
